subject: Can't log into my account
description: After the last password reset my login attempts fail with an authentication error.

subject: 2FA code never arrives
description: The two-factor verification code is not delivered to my phone, I am locked out.

subject: Account locked after vacation
description: My account locked message appears every time I try to sign in with valid credentials.

subject: Session expires too fast
description: The session expired notice appears after two minutes and forces me to log in again.

subject: Dashboard shows an error
description: The analytics dashboard shows a timeout error and sometimes crashes during load.

subject: Export to PDF not working
description: Exporting reports fails with an exception, the button simply does not work anymore.

subject: Page freezes on save
description: The editor freezes when I press save and the browser tab becomes unresponsive.

subject: Sync is very slow
description: Synchronization between devices is slow and often ends with a timeout failure.

subject: Charged twice this month
description: My invoice shows a double charge for the same subscription period, I need a refund.

subject: Question about renewal price
description: The renewal pricing on my latest receipt differs from the plan I originally bought.

subject: Refund still not received
description: I cancelled two weeks ago and the promised refund has not reached my credit card.

subject: Update payment method
description: I need to change the credit card used for billing before the next payment date.

subject: Please add dark mode
description: It would be nice to add support for a dark theme, this is just a suggestion.

subject: Feature request: CSV export
description: An enhancement idea: please add an export of the ticket list to CSV files.

subject: Improvement for search
description: I suggest an improvement so search understands partial matches and typos better.

subject: Crash when uploading avatar
description:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Open profile
2. Upload a PNG avatar
Expected behavior: image saves. Actual behavior: the app crashes with an error.

subject: Wrong totals in report
description:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Create two invoices
2. Open the monthly report
Expected result: totals match. Actual result: the regression shows doubled numbers.

subject: Broken link in welcome email
description: The getting started link returns a 404 page, reproduction is stable on every send.

subject: General question about limits
description: Where can I read about plan limits and how many seats my team can use in total?

subject: Thanks for the great support
description: Just wanted to leave positive feedback about the recent onboarding experience.
